# EagleMinds Coding Guidelines

> Behavioral guidelines for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) built from how LLM coding agents fail in practice. Five rules: understand before you build, build the minimum, change only what the task needs, define done then loop, report what you verified, with a calibration table so trivial tasks skip the ceremony. Ships as a Claude Code plugin skill, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, a Cursor rule, and GitHub Copilot instructions, all generated from one source file. MIT licensed, by EagleMinds (Shankar Venkat).

## Guidelines

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shankar4jazz/eagleminds-coding-guidelines/main/skills/eagleminds-guidelines/SKILL.md): the full guidelines, single source of truth (about 140 lines)
- [examples.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shankar4jazz/eagleminds-coding-guidelines/main/skills/eagleminds-guidelines/references/examples.md): before/after examples for every rule
- [eagleminds-review SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shankar4jazz/eagleminds-coding-guidelines/main/skills/eagleminds-review/SKILL.md): diff review against the rules

## Drop-in files
